messages.S2「落ち着いて…」で自分の振動回数を溜め、10以上になったらS3「ギャンブラー: A Tremor Count supplier that builds his own Count through S2 Steady..., then transfers it all to the enemy with S3 Gamble at 10 or more. He can barely trigger enemy Tremor Bursts himself and needs allies that excel at bursting.
messages.S2「落ち着いて…」: 1コイン、マッチ威力3〜15/4〜16。使用時に自分の振: **S2 — Steady...**: 1 Coin with Clash Power 3–15/4–16. On use, his own Tremor Count increases by 2/4/6, and on hit it inflicts 2/4/6 Tremor (values by Uptie).
messages.S3「ギャンブラー」: 自分の振動回数10につきコイン威力+1(最大2)。Ⅰコイ: **S3 — Gamble**: +1 Coin Power per 10 of his own Tremor Count, up to 2. On Coin Ⅰ hit, if his Tremor Count is 10 or more, he spends all of it and gives the target the same amount of Tremor Count. Below 10, he gains 6/10 Tremor himself and triggers Tremor Burst on himself, dealing that much Blunt damage to the target. This branch advances his own Stagger Threshold, so avoid it if possible.
messages.S1「猛襲」: 4コインだがマッチ威力2〜6と低く、一方攻撃向け。自分の振動回数: **S1 — Fierce Assault**: 4 Coins but with a low Clash Power of 2–6, suited to one-sided attacks. +1 Coin Power with 10 or more of his own Tremor Count. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅳ increase both his and the target's Tremor Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「不安定な出力」(憂鬱×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分の振動回: **Combat passive — Unstable Power Output (4 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: While his own Tremor Count is 10 or more, +1 to the Tremor and Tremor Count inflicted by Coin effects on Heads Hit.
messages.サポートパッシブ「出力改造」(憂鬱×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 体力最大値が最: **Support passive — Modified Power Output (4 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Tremor that the 1 ally with the highest max HP inflicts with attack skills. In Tremor teams, keeping him in backup is also a strong option.
messages.序盤はS2で自分の振動回数を溜める(同期化Ⅳなら2回で10を超える)。10以上に: Early on, build his own Tremor Count with S2 (at Uptie Ⅳ, two uses exceed 10). Once at 10 or more, transfer it all to the enemy with S3 and let allies who are good at bursting trigger it. After the transfer, his own Tremor Count becomes 0, losing S1's and S3's bonuses and the passive's condition, so time it with allies' bursts. Avoid S3 below 10.
